for i in range(len(grid)):
 for j in range(len(grid[0])):
  if (i in fullrows or j in fullcols) and grid[i][j]==9: out2[i][j]=2
print(fullrows,fullcols)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out2))
